changelog: 7 more spoken-punctuation symbols — say "degree sign" / "multiplication sign" / "division sign" / "plus or minus sign" / "copyright sign" / "trademark sign" / "registered sign" (or in Bengali "ডিগ্রি চিহ্ন" / "গুণ চিহ্ন" / "ভাগ চিহ্ন" / "যোগ বিয়োগ চিহ্ন" / "কপিরাইট চিহ্ন" / "ট্রেডমার্ক চিহ্ন" / "রেজিস্টার্ড চিহ্ন") while dictating and ° × ÷ ± © ™ ® appear in your text — e.g. "thirty degree sign" -> "thirty°", "two multiplication sign three" -> "two × three". Needs Spoken punctuation ON in Settings (same as before). Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
